## Functions!

start small with Z scores

``` r
x_vec = rnorm(n = 40, mean = 12, sd = 63)

(x_vec - mean(x_vec)) / sd(x_vec)
```

turn it into function

``` r
z_scores = function(x) {
  
  if (!is.numeric(x)){
    stop("Input x must be numeric.")
  } else if (length(x) < 5) {
    stop("x should have more than 5 numbers")
  }
  z = (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)
  
  return(z)
  
}

z_scores(x_vec)
```

## Mean and sd

``` r
mean(x_vec)
```

    ## [1] 17.79765

``` r
sd(x_vec)
```

    ## [1] 55.86002

write a func that returns mean and sd of an input vector

``` r
mean_and_sd = function(x){
  
  return_df = 
    tibble(
      mean = mean(x),
      sd = sd(x)
    )
  return(return_df)
}
```

check if it works

``` r
source("source/mean_and_sd.R")
```

``` r
mean_and_sd(x_vec)
```

    ## # A tibble: 1 × 2
    ##    mean    sd
    ##   <dbl> <dbl>
    ## 1  17.8  55.9

## Motivate and write another one

``` r
sim_df =
  tibble(
    x = rnorm(40, 12, 3)
  )

sim_df |>
  summarize(
    mean = mean(x),
    sd = sd(x)
  )
```
